ambiguities.text: Keys in window.evmproviders 'RECOMMENDED' to be snake_case - not mandatory requirement
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Treat snake_case as best practice but accept that some providers may use different naming. DApps should handle non-conforming keys gracefully.

ambiguities.text: UUID must be 'consistent across versions' but 'distinct across wallet providers' - boundary between versions vs providers unclear
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume UUID identifies the wallet product (e.g., MetaMask) across all versions, but each distinct wallet product (MetaMask vs Coinbase Wallet) has unique UUID.

ambiguities.text: No specification for handling race conditions when multiple extensions try to create window.evmproviders simultaneously
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume extensions should check for existing namespace before creating, using atomic operations if possible.

implicit_assumptions.description: Wallet extensions are assumed to be installed intentionally by the user and are trusted to inject providers
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malicious browser extensions could inject fake wallet providers to phish users or steal funds

implicit_assumptions.description: DApps will correctly use tags rather than inline SVG when rendering provider icons
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Inline SVG rendering could enable XSS attacks via malicious JavaScript in SVG icons

implicit_assumptions.description: Wallet extensions inject providers before DApp code attempts to enumerate them
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Race condition could cause DApps to miss wallets that inject late, degrading user experience

implicit_assumptions.description: All EIP-1193 security considerations apply to interactions with discovered providers
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Ignoring EIP-1193 security could expose users to unauthorized transactions or account access
